|translation='''Title:''' Lucky Shot.

'''Card text:'''
When activating a weapon targeting a combat vehicle, add X to the weapon destiny. Use this before the weapon destiny is drawn. Used: X equals 1. Lost: X equals 3.

'''Lore:'''
Infantry weapons cannot pierce AT-AT armor, but a blaster bolt rarely hits a gap in the plating. It is a very poor bet, but such odds are nothing new for the Rebellion.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text uses 起動する for targeting and writes USED/LOST as ユーズド／ロスト.
